changes.current_line: Proven ROI, backed by an independent economic impact study.
changes.change: For finance buyers and budget holders: "Put a number on the cost of not fixing it. We'll build your payback case with you, from your own numbers, before it goes to finance." Keep the independent study as a supporting proof point, not the lead. Pair it with a finance-ready one-pager the champion can take to the CFO.
changes.why: The champion said he couldn't get past the CFO "without a number that's ours" and asked for something showing payback, but he got only the generic study deck, nobody ever added up the cost, and finance doesn't fund what "isn't on fire."

changes.current_line: Billing that helps you grow revenue.
changes.change: For product and engineering buyers replacing a homegrown billing system: "Stop billing being a tax on your roadmap. Ship a pricing change in minutes, not a quarter."
changes.why: The buyer rejected the revenue framing outright ("we're not trying to grow revenue with billing, we're trying to stop it being a tax on the roadmap"), and the demo landed when it turned into roadmap time ("a quarter of roadmap in five minutes") against pricing changes that took a quarter.

changes.current_line: Recover failed payments automatically with smart retries.
changes.change: In billing value cases for subscription businesses: "How many subscriptions lapse because a card fails and nobody chases it? Recover them automatically, and see what that leak is costing you today." Use it as a line item in the customer-specific payback number.
changes.why: The champion mentioned that subscriptions lapse when cards fail and nobody chases them, which is a quantifiable cost finance responds to, but nobody ever added it up.

changes.change: For buyers migrating off an existing billing system: "Migrate in stages, on your calendar, around your renewal season," backed by a named customer who has made the same migration and will talk to the buyer, not just a migration doc.
changes.why: The customer's "we don't touch billing before renewal season" shows migration timing and risk was a blocker (the runner-up tag) that we have no messaging line for.
